mapper.sql: c.*, COALESCE(usage_counts.template_count, 0) AS template_count, COALESCE(usage_counts.affected_rule_count, 0) AS affected_rule_count, COALESCE(usage_counts.enabled_affected_rule_count, 0) AS enabled_affected_rule_count
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO alarm_notification_channel (service_name, channel_name, method_type, destination, config) VALUES (#{serviceName}, #{channelName}, #{methodType}, #{destination}, #{config})
mapper.select: SELECT c.* FROM alarm_notification_channel c WHERE c.method_type IN ('EMAIL', 'SMS') AND c.destination = #{userGroupId} ORDER BY c.id FOR UPDATE

SELECT FROM alarm_notification_channel c
WHERE c.id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT FROM alarm_notification_channel c
LEFT JOIN user_group ug ON ug.id = c.destination AND c.method_type IN ('EMAIL', 'SMS') WHERE ( c.method_type NOT IN ('EMAIL', 'SMS') OR ug.id IS NOT NULL ) ORDER BY c.id DESC

SELECT FROM alarm_notification_channel c
LEFT JOIN user_group ug ON ug.id = c.destination AND c.method_type IN ('EMAIL', 'SMS') WHERE AND ( c.method_type NOT IN ('EMAIL', 'SMS') OR ug.id IS NOT NULL ) ORDER BY c.id DESC

SELECT FROM alarm_notification_channel c

SELECT c.* FROM alarm_notification_channel c INNER JOIN alarm_channel_binding b ON c.id = b.channel_id INNER JOIN alarm_rule_v2 r ON ( r.template_item_id IS NULL AND b.owner_type = 'RULE' AND b.owner_id = r.id ) OR ( r.template_item_id IS NOT NULL AND b.owner_type = 'TEMPLATE' AND b.owner_id = ( SELECT ri.template_id FROM alarm_template_item ri WHERE ri.id = r.template_item_id ) ) LEFT JOIN user_group ug ON ug.id = c.destination AND c.method_type IN ('EMAIL', 'SMS') WHERE r.id = #{ruleId} AND ( c.method_type NOT IN ('EMAIL', 'SMS') OR ug.id IS NOT NULL )

SELECT FROM alarm_notification_channel c INNER JOIN ( SELECT b.channel_id FROM alarm_channel_binding b INNER JOIN alarm_rule_v2 r ON r.id = b.owner_id AND r.template_item_id IS NULL WHERE b.owner_type = 'RULE' AND r.service_name = #{serviceName} AND r.application_name = #{applicationName} AND r.application_type = #{applicationType} UNION SELECT b.channel_id FROM alarm_channel_binding b INNER JOIN alarm_template_item i ON i.template_id = b.owner_id INNER JOIN alarm_rule_v2 r ON r.template_item_id = i.id WHERE b.owner_type = 'TEMPLATE' AND r.service_name = #{serviceName} AND r.application_name = #{applicationName} AND r.application_type = #{applicationType} ) app_channels ON app_channels.channel_id = c.id
LEFT JOIN user_group ug ON ug.id = c.destination AND c.method_type IN ('EMAIL', 'SMS') WHERE ( c.method_type NOT IN ('EMAIL', 'SMS') OR ug.id IS NOT NULL ) ORDER BY c.id DESC
